description: Record a cost in your workspace, such as a vendor or infrastructure cost, so the Value Receipt and the cost analytics count it: pass amount, and optionally currency (default USD), cost_type (default usage), agent_id, customer_id and metadata. This writes a record that is not undone by another tool, so record what was really spent. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: The agent: its id, as it shows in your workspace. An agent's own credential can name only its own agent.

amount.description: What it cost, in the currency.

cost_type.description: What kind of cost it is. Defaults to usage.

currency.description: The currency code. Defaults to USD.

customer_id.description: The customer: its id, as it shows in your workspace.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

name: record_cost
